learning_outcomes.text: Understands the basic elements of computer-aided drawing and design (CAD)
Uses CAD package programs for two-dimensional (2D) technical drawing applications
Uses CAD package programs for three-dimensional (3D) solid modeling applications
Performs two-dimensional (2D) applications and design in CAD program
Makes three-dimensional (3D) applications and design in CAD program

syllabus_topics: Introduction to contemporary CAD programs. Explaining of a CAD program interface.
Line, circle and arc drawings by using a CAD program.
Ellipse and polygon drawings and hatching by using a CAD program.
Zooming, scaling, mirroring, copying, moving, deleting, array applications.
Primitive solids, solid modelling with adding, subtracting and intersections.
Solid modelling with extrude, revolve, sweep and loft. Editing commands of the solids.
Solid modelling with extrude, revolve, sweep and loft. Editing commands of the solids.
View extraction from solid modelling. Rendering.
teaching_methods: Explanation and application of drawing commands
bibliography: B. BOSTANCIOĞLU ve N. BOSTANCIOĞLU, “AutoCAD 2007 2D/3D Tasarım”, Değişim yayınları, 2006, İstanbul.
